name: Winctl2Rust Windows Control & Automation Console
description: 100% pure-Rust non-hooking Windows command launcher, CoreAudio volume/rule controller, DDC/CI & EDID display manager, desktop/clipboard/font/webcam inspector, CLI, dual Win32/Iced GUIs, and policy-gated MCP server.
majorCapabilities: Non-hooking command script runner, launch profiles, parent-attributed spawning & Task Scheduler v2
CoreAudio endpoint/session control, CLI verbs, PropertyStore per-app routing & mouse wheel volume rules
VESA EDID 1.3/1.4 + CEA-861 parser, CCD multi-monitor layout & DDC/CI VCP control
Desktop window/clipboard/hotkey/keyboard/OpenType font/Media Foundation webcam tools
Policy-gated stdio MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server, dual Win32/Iced GUIs & Merkle audit exports

tools.summary: Inspect per-application Windows PolicyConfig\PropertyStore audio settings
Inspect CoreAudio CLI verb grammar and live resolvable target selectors
Enumerate CoreAudio endpoints, topology subunits, and per-application audio sessions
Inspect mouse wheel and modifier volume rules (in-process WM_INPUT engine)
List Windows Task Scheduler v2 tasks in the root folder
Enumerate candidate parent processes for parent-attributed launch via ToolHelp32
Inspect and validate process launch profiles
Parse and preview command script DSL statements (non-hooking pure-Rust parser)
Browse local SQLite clipboard history archive
Inspect active Windows clipboard formats, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, and previews
Read SysListView32/SysTreeView32/ListBox/ComboBox text via non-injecting cross-process messages
Enumerate installed Windows fonts and decode OpenType name/OS2 tables
Probe global hotkeys via RegisterHotKey and decode [MS-SHLLINK] .lnk wHotKey bindings
Inspect virtual key pressed/toggled states, scan codes, and localized key names
Inspect top-level and child window properties, styles, bounds, and owning process
Walk recursive HWND parent/child window trees and inspect control IDs, classes, and text
Enumerate Media Foundation video capture devices and native frame capabilities
List open top-level windows with placement state and bounds
Query DDC/CI VCP features and MCCS 2.2a monitor capabilities
Parse and inspect VESA EDID 1.3/1.4 and CEA-861 monitor descriptor blocks
Correlate live DisplayConfig monitor targets with EDID serials, gamma, primaries, and max timings
Enumerate multi-monitor topology, resolution, DPI scale, orientation, and primary display
Update or remove per-application PolicyConfig\PropertyStore binary volume/mute/channel blobs
Parse and execute CoreAudio CLI control verbs against CoreAudio endpoints and sessions
Control CoreAudio endpoint/session volume, mute, default roles, and device enable/disable state
Evaluate or apply mouse wheel and modifier volume rules via in-process WM_INPUT (no DLL injection)
Schedule or dry-run preview a one-shot delayed task via Windows Task Scheduler v2 ITaskService
Launch a child process with parent-process attribution via PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS (non-injecting)
Launch or dry-run preview an executable using a launch profile
Read-only parser and validator for JSON or INI launch profiles
Parse, dry-run preview, or execute command script DSL lines without DLL injection or API hooking
Read-only parser and R4 validator for command script DSL inputs
Capture, restore, delete, clear, or export/import local SQLite/JSON clipboard history
Clear the Windows clipboard or set CF_UNICODETEXT content
Control window visibility, enabled state, topmost z-order, opacity, or close via Win32 APIs
Update child/control window text, size, position, or visibility
Capture a still frame from a Media Foundation webcam and save as 24-bit BMP or P6 PPM
Minimize, maximize, restore, focus, or close an open window

Apply multi-monitor display topology changes (primary, enable/disable, move, resolution, orientation, save/load profile)
